derivation.rationale: The same SEO assessment work checked whether a site declares its sitemap and whether that sitemap is usable. The capability is site-independent.
varied: target page: the site the SEO assessment was about

deterministic_evidence.detail: robots.txt and sitemap.xml are re-fetched at verify time

instruction: Open the rajeevg.com homepage. From that page, fetch /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml (same origin), then record your finding by setting window.__bench_finding with ONE eval to a JSON object with exactly these keys: {"robotsPresent": true if /robots.txt responded ok, "robotsSitemaps": [every Sitemap: URL declared in robots.txt, absolute and sorted], "sitemapUrlCount": the number of <loc> entries in the sitemap XML, "allSameHost": true if every <loc> entry is on the site's own hostname}. Do not change the site. Finish only after window.__bench_finding is set.
objective: On the live rajeevg.com, verify the site's crawlability declarations: does robots.txt exist, which sitemap URLs does it declare, how many URLs does the sitemap list, and are all of them on the site's own host?

pre_state.detail: navigate to the public homepage in a fresh browser context; no account, no login

provenance.verified_against: window.__bench_finding matches the recomputed robots.txt declarations and sitemap entry count for the live site

raw_task_statement: can we look at bringing back some of the programmatic seo stuff on Rajeevg.com ... just assess what we can reintroduce whilst still keeping the site clean and focused

verification.description: Independent recomputation of the crawlability facts by fetching robots.txt and sitemap.xml from the live page, compared to the agent's window.__bench_finding.
verification.verify_js: (async()=>{const abs=u=>{try{return new URL(u,location.href).href}catch(e){return null}};let robots=null;let sitemaps=[];let urls=[];let sameHost=null;let err=null;try{const r=await fetch('/robots.txt',{cache:'no-store'});robots=r.ok?await r.text():null;if(robots){sitemaps=[...new Set([...robots.matchAll(/Sitemap:\s*(\S+)/gi)].map(m=>abs(m[1])).filter(Boolean))].sort()}}catch(e){err='robots:'+e}try{const s=await fetch('/sitemap.xml',{cache:'no-store'});const t=s.ok?await s.text():'';urls=[...new Set([...t.matchAll(/<loc>\s*([^<\s]+)\s*<\/loc>/gi)].map(m=>m[1].trim()))];sameHost=urls.length?urls.every(u=>{try{return new URL(u).hostname===location.hostname}catch(e){return false}}):null}catch(e){err=(err||'')+' sitemap:'+e}let f=null;try{f=window.__bench_finding||null;}catch(e){}return JSON.stringify({url:location.href,truth:{robotsPresent:!!robots,robotsSitemaps:sitemaps,sitemapUrlCount:urls.length,allSameHost:sameHost},finding:f,error:err});})()
